Pixel-perfect Webflow → Next.js port for 3 form-driven routes in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq.

Routes to fix:
1. /contact  →  src/app/contact/page.tsx + src/components/contact/*
2. /book-a-demo  →  src/app/book-a-demo/page.tsx + src/components/book-a-demo/*
3. /newsletter  →  src/app/newsletter/page.tsx + src/components/newsletter/* (if exists)

GOAL: Match `https://boldteq.com/contact`, `https://boldteq.com/book-a-demo`, `https://boldteq.com/newsletter` 100%. Webflow source: `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/contact.html`, `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/book-a-demo.html`, `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/newsletter.html`.

WORKFLOW PER PAGE:
A. Read Webflow source HTML
B. Read local page.tsx + components
C. Verify section render order, missing/extra, CSS divergence
D. Grep Webflow CSS at all 5 breakpoints — port verbatim
E. Forms: client-side Zod validation + server action handler. If no /api endpoint exists, stub with `'use server'` action that logs + returns success.
F. Add SEO Metadata
G. All images: next/image
H. `pnpm build` 0 errors

WEBFLOW MEDIA QUERY MAP:
- Default
- @media (min-width: 1280px)  (line 21619)
- @media (min-width: 1440px)  (line 23146)
- @media (max-width: 991px)   (line 24454)
- @media (max-width: 767px)   (line 26907)
- @media (max-width: 479px)   (line 29202)

CONTACT-SPECIFIC (per CLAUDE.md):
- 3 info cards: Sales (sales@boldteq.com), Support (support@boldteq.com), Career (hr@boldteq.com)
- Form: First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, "What Are You Looking For?" dropdown (Start a New Project, Agency Partnership, Technical or Account Support, Join Our Team, General Inquiry), Message
- Success: "Thank you! Your submission has been received! Our team will get back to you within 12-24hrs."
- Form should validate on blur + submit, show inline errors

BOOK-A-DEMO-SPECIFIC:
- Calendly embed (or similar booking iframe) — match Webflow's iframe URL exactly
- Hero with value props above the booking widget
- Trust badges

NEWSLETTER-SPECIFIC:
- Email input + submit
- Privacy guarantee line
- Success message

CONSTRAINTS:
- TypeScript strict, no `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `console.log`
- Next.js 16 Server Actions for form submission
- All form inputs have `<label>` (a11y)
- All forms have aria-live region for status messages
- Mobile-first, all 5 breakpoints
- Stack A only — no Stripe, use Resend if email needed

OUTPUT: 1-line summary per route + build result.
